verdict.rationale: Durable workflows are a fair question for a serverless/edge hosting platform like Netlify, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows generic serverless functions, storage and databases. Nothing documents durable, long-running workflows with built-in queues or retries; serverless functions are at most a developer building block and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy durable, long-running workflows as code without manually wiring queues and retries
